name: Klothys
description: The god of fate and jailer of the titans, who leaves the Underworld and creates Calix.

description_citations.text: "War of the Gods". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The gods, born from mortal prayer, seal the titans away in the Underworld with Klothys as eternal jailer.
timeline.quote: the gods sealed the titans away in the Underworld

citation.text: "Theros (plane)", section "The sealing of the titans". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The other gods call their champions from the Underworld and war breaks out; rifts to the Underworld release monsters and Polukranos besieges Setessa.
timeline.quote: The giant nyxborn hydra Polukranos laid siege to Setessa , which was defended by Haktos .

citation.text: "War of the Gods", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Klothys leaves the Underworld, leaving the titans unguarded for the first time in millennia.
timeline.quote: leaving the titans unguarded for the first time in millennia.

citation.text: "War of the Gods", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Klothys weaves Calix to pursue Elspeth; Elspeth defeats him repeatedly on her way to the exit.
timeline.quote: So Klothys weaved her masterpiece: an agent of fate she called Calix .

citation.text: "War of the Gods", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Klothys sets out to mend the destiny of Theros.
timeline.quote: Klothys set out to mend the destiny of Theros, her fury guiding every stitch.

citation.text: Furious Rise (Theros Beyond Death, 2020), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Long ago the titans are sealed in the Underworld and Klothys volunteers as their eternal jailer.
timeline.quote: it was Klothys who volunteered to serve as their eternal jailer.

citation.text: "Klothys", section "The binding of the titans". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Klothys, livid at souls reversing their deaths, dispatches Agents of Fate and creates Calix to deal with Elspeth's soul.
timeline.quote: For this task, Klothys created Calix .

citation.text: "Klothys", section "Return to the mortal world". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Klothys sends agents after defiers of fate; Niko's spark ignites in the confrontation and they leave Theros.
timeline.quote: but during this confrontation, Niko's spark ignited and they left the plane.

citation.text: "Niko Aris", section "Theros Beyond Death". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The gods are at war and bring their champions to fight.
timeline.quote: The Gods are at war, and they bring their champions to fight.

citation.text: "Theros Beyond Death", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Klothys learns Elspeth has escaped the Underworld and sends someone to bring her back or capture her.
timeline.quote: Klothys finds out about Elspeth escaping the Underworld so she is sending someone to bring her back to the Underworld or capture her.

citation.text: "Theros Beyond Death", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Klothys and Kruphix war against the titans and seal them in the Underworld with Klothys watching.
timeline.quote: Victorious, the twin gods sealed the Titans in the Underworld with Klothys to keep watch.

citation.text: "Underworld", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Klothys leaves the Underworld after the apotheosis of Xenagos.
timeline.quote: Klothys has lived in the Underworld ever since the binding of the Titans, but she left following the apotheosis of Xenagos to untangle the threads of fate in the mortal world.

citation.text: "Underworld", section "Gods". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Klothys traps Heliod in the Underworld as punishment for his hubris.
timeline.quote: Following the events of Theros Beyond Death , Heliod became trapped in the Underworld by Klothys as punishment for his hubris.

citation.text: "Underworld", section "Gods". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Klothys is furious that souls escaped the Underworld and weaves the Agent of Fate Calix to pursue Elspeth.
timeline.quote: Klothys weaved her masterpiece — the Agent of Fate called Calix.

citation.text: "Calix", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The gods sealed the titans away in the Underworld, with Klothys as eternal jailer.
timeline.quote: the gods sealed the titans away in the Underworld

citation.text: "Kroxa", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Klothys plants the Enorasi in the Nessian Wood.
timeline.quote: an enormous olive tree which was planted in the Nessian Wood by

citation.text: "Nessian Wood", section "Locations in the Nessian Wood". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.note: Calix pursues Elspeth by Klothys's order.
relations.quote: He dreams about his quarry dictated by Klothys

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Chapter 4: The Dark
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Chapter 4: The Dark" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Oct 2022.

relations.note: created solely to carry out her will
relations.quote: Created solely to carry out the will of Klothys
